label: Crawl Site
description: Crawl a site from a starting URL and emit every reached page as clean markdown. Runs as long as the crawl takes; the page limit bounds cost.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Firecrawl access (wire a FirecrawlAccess node).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: Max pages
inputs.description: Upper bound on crawled pages (1-1000); the crawl bills per page.
